articles.body: Not as the title says but are those officers and armies already committed to deploy in the round also out of the defence in response to crisis?
articles.bodyXml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<xml><safehtml>Not as the title says but are those officers and armies already committed to deploy in the round also out of the defence in response to crisis?</safehtml></xml>

articles.body: Yes. Officers, armies, and local alliances can only participate in the defense if they are not exhausted, that is, if they were not used in a Deploy action in the same turn. Note that in order to Mount a Defense (page 33, fourth bullet point) the Commander [i]must exhaust[/i] pieces in the Army, and an already exhausted piece cannot be exhausted again in that turn.
articles.bodyXml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<xml><safehtml>Yes. Officers, armies, and local alliances can only participate in the defense if they are not exhausted, that is, if they were not used in a Deploy action in the same turn. Note that in order to Mount a Defense (page 33, fourth bullet point) the Commander <em>must exhaust</em> pieces in the Army, and an already exhausted piece cannot be exhausted again in that turn.</safehtml></xml>
